declarations.name: exists_evalOneAt_ne_zero_of_not_dvd

declarations.name: exists_nonzero_soninCarrier_zeta_dvd
declarations.doc: The `K_a` half of Proposition 6.4 for `a < 1`.** Below aperture one the evaluators are not complete in the Sonine space either.

declarations.name: deningerPointedMulRoot_exists_iff_card_dvd
declarations.doc: Deninger, Lemma 4.6(2).** Over an algebraically closed field with finite `P⁻¹(1)`, a pointed multiplicative `N`-th root of `P` exists exactly when the order of `μ_N (K)` divides the order of `P⁻¹(1)`.

declarations.name: exists_norm_polyEval_div_le_of_dvd
declarations.doc: A rational function whose numerator vanishes to order `N` is `O(‖u‖^N)` near the origin.**

declarations.name: exists_norm_polyEval_div_pow_le_of_dvd
declarations.doc: A polynomial vanishing to order `N` is `O(‖u‖^N)` on the half disc**, even after division by a power of `1 + u`.

declarations.name: privateSector_card_le_totalDegree_of_dvd
declarations.doc: Every nonzero charge divisible by the full transverse product has augmentation degree at least the number of transverse directions. Combined with `TelescopeIdeal`'s intersection-equals- product theorem, this is the lower bound for every private charge on a free orbit.

declarations.name: pow_dvd_card_of_dyadic_boundaryCompletedJetWeyl
declarations.doc: At dyadic depth `k`, a nonzero boundary wrap forces `2^k` to divide the jet dimension.

declarations.name: deckInteriorChargeProfile_modulus_dvd_support_card
declarations.doc: Generator-valued conserved deck charge occupies a multiple of `n` interior boxes.

declarations.name: exists_homogeneous_eval_eq_of_card_sub_one_le
declarations.doc: Every function on a finite normalized embedded point family is represented by a homogeneous polynomial in every degree at least `card V - 1`.

declarations.name: X_pow_dvd_of_eval_bound
declarations.doc: Polynomial order detection.** A polynomial whose values along a nonzero null sequence in the closed unit disc are `O(|w|^n)` is divisible by `X^n`.

declarations.name: nat_card_criticalFibre_eq_solutions
declarations.doc: The fibre of an observation is its system's solution set**, at arbitrary depths. Everything about jets, truncation and compatibility has been discharged; what is left of `(2)` is a count of solutions of an explicit square polynomial system.

declarations.name: exists_not_C_pow_dvd
declarations.doc: A nonzero polynomial is not divisible by every power of a uniformizer.

declarations.name: exists_nonzero_root_of_natDegree_pos_eval_zero_ne
declarations.doc: A positive-degree complex polynomial whose constant term is nonzero has a nonzero root.

declarations.name: exists_sameObservedGrade_mate_of_regularCharacter_eq_zero
declarations.doc: Every nonzero atom of a vanishing regular character packet has a distinct nonzero mate in the same observed-frequency fibre.

declarations.name: nonzeroPauliWord_empty_or_exists_coefficientEnergy_le_card_mul
declarations.doc: Non-scalar Pauli dictionary is empty, or one non-scalar word carries at least its average squared coefficient energy.

declarations.name: exists_vinogradovBertrandPrimeReservoir_not_dvd
declarations.doc: If nonzero `A` is at most `y^M`, one of the first `M+1` Bertrand primes above `y` does not divide `A`.

declarations.name: exists_nonzero_eval₂_square_form_deckSpecialized_yDerivLowerTruncationX_topCoeff_sign_invariant
declarations.doc: Evaluated single-branch square form for the nonzero relocated top coefficient.

declarations.name: isSolvable_of_card_dvd_two_prime_powers
declarations.doc: Burnside's `p ^ a q ^ b` theorem** for a finite group in any universe.

exploration.name: exists_small_dvd_dotProd
exploration.doc: Pigeonhole in the index-`q` sublattice.** If `(Q+1)^n > q ≥ 1` then some nonzero integer vector with coordinates bounded by `Q` pairs to a multiple of `q` against `p`.

exploration.name: isSolvable_of_card_dvd_prime_pow_mul_prime_pow
exploration.doc: Burnside's `p ^ a q ^ b` theorem.** A finite group whose order has at most two prime divisors is solvable.
